title: Red Glass Highway
style: Dark 80s synthwave, 104 BPM, driving pulse bass, gated snare, shimmering arpeggios, moody minor chords, cool breathy female vocal, rain-slick city highway at night, retro thriller atmosphere
negativeTags: pop, country, acoustic, happy, ballad, chiptune, modern pop
lyrics:
[Verse]
Taillights bleeding through the rain
You never told me your real name
Engine humming, hands on chrome
Nowhere left that feels like home

[Chorus]
Red glass highway, take me far
Chasing ghosts in a borrowed car
Red glass highway, hold on tight
We disappear into the night

[Bridge]
Don't look back, don't look back
The road is gone, the sky is black
